events.verdict: Trent Jr. (MIL) places a hand against Edwards' (MIN) body while he is already off-balance and the contact is marginal.
Gobert (MIN) firms up in a screening position and the contact with Porter Jr. (MIL) is marginal.
Edwards (MIN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.

Lopez (MIL) establishes himself in a screening position in Alexander-Walker's (MIN) path and turns along with him. Lopez avoids delivering any illegal contact as Alexander-Walker moves around the screen.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms if Porter Jr. (MIL) makes illegal contact to Edwards' (MIN) arm during his jump shot attempt.
Trent Jr. (MIL) briefly places a hand on Alexander-Walker's (MIN) shoulder and the contact during the rebound is marginal.
Reid (MIN) jumps forward into Prince's (MIL) lower body, initiating illegal contact that causes him to fall to the floor.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Lopez (MIL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Although Reid (MIN) makes contact with the ball, there is no clear and conclusive evidence to overturn the on-court ruling that Lopez is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Porter Jr. (MIL) leans into Alexander-Walker (MIN), who is not dislodged from his defensive position as a result of the marginal contact.
Porter Jr. (MIL) backs into Edwards (MIN) and the contact with his head/face is incidental.
Gobert (MIN) briefly places a hand on Lopez (MIL) on the perimeter, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Gobert (MIN) moves underneath Lopez (MIL) and initiates illegal lower body contact that affects his shot attempt.
